import numpy as np
def checked(fn):
    bad = [(np.zeros((2,3)),0.0), (np.array([[1.,0.,1.]]),0.0),
           (np.array([[1.,-2.,1.],[0.,1.,0.]]),1.0),
           (np.array([[-1.,1.],[np.nan,0.]]),1.0),
           (np.ones((8,2)),0.0), (np.array([[-1+0j,1+0j]]),1.0)]
    for C,x in bad:
        try: fn(C.copy(),x)
        except ValueError: continue
        return 0
    return 1
assert np.allclose(checked(continue_condition_jets), target)
